title: Isolation of Mitochondria From Yeast to Estimate Mitochondrial Pools of Inorganic Phosphate
author: Swagata Adhikary
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (CEN.PK background [12]), with FLAG-tagged Tom20 (Tom20 protein with a 3×-FLAG epitope tag included at the endogenous C-terminal locus) [11] Reagents
Sorbitol (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: S6021, CAS number: 50-70-
DTT (1,4-Dithiothreitol) (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: D0632, CAS number: 3483-12-
HEPES buffer [4-(2-hydroxyethyl) piperazine-1-ethane-sulfonic acid] (HIMEDIA, catalog number: RM380, CAS number: 7365-45-
Leupeptin hemisulfate (Selleck Chemicals, catalog number: S
Anti-FLAG mouse antibody (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: F
HPLC-grade water (Fisher Chemical, Water, Optima LC-MS Grade, CAS number: 7732-18-
Malachite Green Phosphate Assay kit (Cayman chemicals, catalog number:
BCA Protein Estimation kit (G-biosciences, catalog number: 786-
Sulfuric acid (H 2 SO 4 ) (Fischer scientific, catalog number: Q29995 ) Solutions

steps.title: Prepare Tris‑DTT buffer stock
steps.instruction: Weigh 12.11 g Tris base, dissolve in 80 mL MilliQ water, adjust pH to 9.4 with H₂SO₄, bring volume to 100 mL (1 M Tris‑H₂SO₄); prepare 1 M DTT stock, store at –20 °C; mix 100 mM Tris‑H₂SO₄ with 10 mM DTT, pre‑warm to 30 °C for 15 min before use.

steps.title: Prepare sorbitol solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 87.4 g sorbitol in ~90 mL water, make up to 200 mL, autoclave, store at room temperature (up to 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare HEPES‑KOH solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11.915 g HEPES in water, adjust pH to 7.4 with KOH, bring volume to 50 mL (1 M), autoclave and store at room temperature (up to 1 year).

steps.title: Make SEH buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 75 mL 2.4 M sorbitol, 6 mL 1 M HEPES‑KOH, add water to a final volume of 300 mL (219 mL water). Use fresh for each experiment; optionally add 1 mM EDTA.

steps.title: Add protease inhibitors to SEH
steps.instruction: To fresh SEH buffer add 0.207 mL 1.45 mM pepstatin (ethanol stock, dissolve at 60 °C), 0.6 mL 50 mM leupeptin (final 100 µM), optionally 1 mM PMSF; prepare immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare zymolyase solution
steps.instruction: For each gram of wet yeast pellet, add 25 mg zymolyase to 5 mL SEH buffer (total 5 mL). Prepare fresh.

steps.title: Prepare growth media
steps.instruction: Make 50 % (w/v) glucose stock, filter‑sterilize. For YPD: autoclave 1 % yeast extract + 2 % peptone in water (YP), then add 2 % glucose from stock (e.g., 96 mL YP + 4 mL 50 % glucose for 100 mL). For YPE: add 2 % ethanol to autoclaved YP (2 mL ethanol + 98 mL YP for 100 mL).

steps.title: Grow primary yeast culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate S. cerevisiae (Tom20‑FLAG) into 25 mL YPD, incubate 16 h at 30 °C, 250 rpm shaking.

steps.title: Start secondary culture to mid‑log
steps.instruction: Use primary culture to inoculate secondary culture; grow to OD₆₀₀ ≈ 0.6–0.8. Use 150 mL ethanol medium or 300 mL glucose medium as needed.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge culture at 1,500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in ice‑cold water, repeat centrifugation (1,500 × g, 5 min, 4 °C). Weigh wet pellet (wet weight).

steps.title: Incubate in Tris‑DTT buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in Tris‑DTT buffer at 5 mL per gram wet weight, incubate 15 min at 30 °C with shaking (250 rpm). Pre‑warm buffer to 30 °C. Prepare zymolyase solution during this incubation.

steps.title: Wash with SEH buffer
steps.instruction: Wash pellet with SEH buffer (5 mL per gram wet weight), centrifuge 1,500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Spheroplast formation with zymolyase
steps.instruction: Add zymolyase solution (25 mg zymolyase per gram wet weight in 5 mL SEH) to pellet, incubate 30 °C, 250 rpm shaking for 45 min–1 h.

steps.title: Collect spheroplasts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4,500 × g for 5 min (extend to ≥10 min if rotor max <4,500 × g), wash spheroplast pellet with ice‑cold SEH (5 mL per gram), resuspend in ice‑cold SEH with protease inhibitors (5 mL per gram).

steps.title: Homogenize cells
steps.instruction: Using a pre‑chilled glass Dounce grinder on ice, perform 15 forceful strokes (~1–1.5 min total). Keep tube less than half full to avoid spillage.

steps.title: Low‑speed spin to remove debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge homogenate 1,500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Collect pellet P1 (membranes, vacuole, debris) and supernatant S1 (cytosol, mitochondria, ER).

steps.title: High‑speed spin for mitochondria‑enriched fraction
steps.instruction: Spin S1 at 12,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Collect pellet P2 (mitochondria‑enriched fraction, MEF) and supernatant S2 (cytosol). Weigh P2.

steps.title: Resuspend MEF in SEH with inhibitors
steps.instruction: Resuspend P2 in ice‑cold SEH buffer containing protease inhibitors at 1 mL per gram wet weight.

steps.title: Remove large organelles
steps.instruction: Centrifuge suspension from previous step at 700 × g for 5 min, collect supernatant; then centrifuge that supernatant at 1,500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Collect supernatant S3.

steps.title: Obtain crude mitochondria (P3)
steps.instruction: Spin S3 at 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, collect pellet P3 (crude mitochondria), weigh pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend crude mitochondria
steps.instruction: Resuspend P3 in ice‑cold SEH buffer with protease inhibitors (1 mL per gram wet weight). This fraction may be used for protein/activity assays.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation: resuspend P2
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet P2 (from step 9) in 700 µL ice‑cold SEH with protease inhibitors. Perform all following steps in a cold room.

steps.title: Prepare Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1.5 mg Dynabeads Protein G (50 µL of 30 mg/mL stock) into a 1.5 mL tube, place in magnetic rack for 30 s, aspirate liquid, wash beads with 100 µL SEH buffer.

steps.title: Couple anti‑FLAG antibody
steps.instruction: Resuspend washed beads in 100 µL SEH buffer, add 10 µg anti‑FLAG antibody, incubate 15 min with gentle rotation (15 rpm) on a cyclomixer.

steps.title: Bind mitochondria to beads
steps.instruction: Add the mitochondrial suspension (from immunoprecipitation step 1) to the antibody‑coated beads, mix, incubate 30–60 min with gentle rotation (15 rpm).

steps.title: Collect flowthrough
steps.instruction: Place beads in magnetic rack for 1 min, remove supernatant (unbound mitochondria).

steps.title: Wash immunoprecipitated beads
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 300 µL ice‑cold SEH buffer.

steps.title: Elute purified mitochondria
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 10 µL SEH buffer plus 30 µL FLAG peptide (2 mg/mL stock, final 1.5 mg/mL), incubate at room temperature for 30 min with intermittent mixing.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Place tube in magnetic rack for 1–2 min, transfer supernatant (purified mitochondria) to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Pellet purified mitochondria
steps.instruction: Centrifuge eluate at 12,000 × g for 5 min; pellet contains purified mitochondria.

steps.title: Extract inorganic phosphate
steps.instruction: Resuspend purified mitochondrial pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold LC‑MS‑grade water.

steps.title: Lyse mitochondria by bead beating
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL glass beads, bead‑beat 3 × 20 s with 30–60 s cooling between beats.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysate at 20,000 × g (14,000 rpm) for 1 min at 4 °C, collect 700–800 µL supernatant (contains inorganic phosphate). Store at 4 °C (short‑term) or –80 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure protein in the supernatant using a BCA Protein Estimation kit (note that low DTT and absence of PMSF avoid interference).

steps.title: Prepare phosphate standards
steps.instruction: Dilute the 1 M phosphate standard (kit) in LC‑MS‑grade water to 12.5, 6.25, 3.13, and 1.56 µM; use water as 0 µM blank. Aliquot 50 µL of each standard into a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Dilute mitochondrial lysates
steps.instruction: Dilute the supernatant from step 23 1:5 and 1:10 with LC‑MS‑grade water to a final volume of 100 µL.

steps.title: Add samples to plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL of each diluted sample (and optionally undiluted sample) into wells of the same 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add Malachite Green reagents
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL MG acidic solution to each well, mix gently, incubate at room temperature for 10 min; then add 15 µL MG Blue solution, mix gently, incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Read absorbance at 620 nm (620–640 nm) using a microplate reader.

steps.title: Calculate and normalize Pi
steps.instruction: Generate a standard curve from the phosphate standards, calculate Pi concentrations in samples, and normalize to total protein (from BCA) or to a mitochondrial marker (Tom20/Idh1) as desired.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol has been used and validated in the following research article: Vengayil et al. [11]. The deubiquitinase Ubp3/Usp10 constrains glucose-mediated mitochondrial repression via phosphate budgeting. eLife (Figure 4B, Figure 4, supplement 1A). Three biological replicates were used in these experiments; the data provided in Figure 1 in this protocol are from two biological replicates.
